observations: The selected archetype remained a flat colored polygon before Generate to 3D.
Generate to 3D persisted the exact Batch 19 family, variant, appearance kit, planting structure, and metric target.
The compiled globe showed six parcel-fitted food-truck volumes, communal picnic tables, overhead string-light runs, perimeter planting, and the archetype-derived industrial surface.
The park polygon flattened the Google tile surface beneath the LEGO program.

An initial Night-Market v3 attempt correctly failed the exact-family size envelope on this 1,193 m2 parcel; the compact Industrial Pop-Up v0 now carries its own 500-1,500 m2 envelope instead of inheriting the permanent park minimum.

The first browser attempt was connected to a different backend and produced only the generic fallback layer; reconnecting the frontend to the matching Batch 19 backend made the exact recipe authoritative.
